description: This file defines the ResourceNameConverter class, which handles resource name validation, variant generation, and reference creation for Android resource names within the project.

classes.name: ResourceNameConverter
classes.description: A converter class for Android resource names, providing validation, variant suggestions, and reference creation.

classes.name: MyParentStyleReference
classes.description: A nested class extending AndroidResourceReferenceBase, providing quick fixes for style references.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string resource name to a validated resource name if it is a valid Java identifier and not a keyword.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the resource name.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Provides an error message if the resource name is invalid according to Android resource naming rules.

methods.name: getVariants
methods.description: Generates possible resource name variants based on the current context, especially for style names.

methods.name: getStyleNameVariants
methods.description: Helper method to get style name variants from the resource manager.

methods.name: createReferences
methods.description: Creates PSI references for resource names within style elements.

methods.name: getReferencesInStyleName
methods.description: Generates references for style names, handling parent style references.

methods.name: hasExplicitParent
methods.description: Checks if a style resource has an explicit parent style.
